blocks.tex:
The failure of continuous selection is a statement about actual polygons.
The separating quantity is the reciprocal radius of their smallest enclosing
disk. This chapter supplies the contact geometry, the two containing circles,
and the endpoint inequalities used by that argument.

Write $v=(v_i)_{i\in\mathbb Z/n}$, let $r_i$ be the circumradius of
$(v_{i-1},v_i,v_{i+1})$, and put $\kappa_i=1/r_i$ when the polygon has positive
orientation. In the coherent case, the local circumcenter lies in the cone
at $v_i$ generated by its two neighbours. A contact of a containing disk is
a vertex on its boundary.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-radius-continuous
blocks.title: The smallest enclosing radius is continuous
blocks.body:
Every nonempty finite vertex set has a smallest enclosing disk. Its radius
$R(v)$ satisfies
\[
 |R(v)-R(w)|\le\max_i|v_i-w_i|.
\]
For a simple polygon $R(v)>0$. Consequently $c(v)=1/R(v)$ is continuous
on the space of simple polygons.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.enclosingDisk_minimal
lean.code:
theorem enclosingDisk_minimal {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (v : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    MinimalEnclosingDiskR2 v (enclosingCenter v) (enclosingRadius v) :=
  (exists_minimalEnclosingDiskR2 v).choose_spec.choose_spec

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.enclosingRadius_lipschitz
lean.code:
theorem enclosingRadius_lipschitz {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] :
    LipschitzWith 1 (enclosingRadius (n := n)) := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro v w
  rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_le]
  have hv := enclosingRadius_le_add_dist v w
  have hw := enclosingRadius_le_add_dist w v
  simp only [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul]
  constructor <;> linarith [dist_comm v w]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.enclosingRadius_le_add_dist
lean.code:
theorem enclosingRadius_le_add_dist {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (v w : ZMod n → ℂ) : enclosingRadius v ≤ enclosingRadius w + dist v w := by
  have hv := enclosingDisk_minimal v
  have hw := enclosingDisk_minimal w
  apply hv.2.2 (enclosingCenter w) _ (add_nonneg hw.1 dist_nonneg)
  intro i
  apply Metric.mem_closedBall'.mpr
  calc
    dist (enclosingCenter w) (v i) ≤
        dist (enclosingCenter w) (w i) + dist (w i) (v i) := dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ enclosingRadius w + dist v w := add_le_add
      (Metric.mem_closedBall'.mp (hw.2.1 i))
      (by simpa [dist_comm] using dist_le_pi_dist w v i)

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.exists_minimalEnclosingDiskR2
lean.code:
theorem exists_minimalEnclosingDiskR2 {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (v : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    ∃ O R, MinimalEnclosingDiskR2 v O R := by
  obtain ⟨O, hmin⟩ :=
    (continuous_finiteEnclosingRadius v).exists_forall_le
      (tendsto_finiteEnclosingRadius_cocompact_atTop v)
  refine ⟨O, finiteEnclosingRadius v O, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact dist_nonneg.trans
      (Finset.le_sup' (fun i : ZMod n => dist O (v i)) (Finset.mem_univ 0))
  · exact polygonInClosedDiskR2_finiteEnclosingRadius v O
  · intro O' R' _hR' hpoly
    exact (hmin O').trans
      (Finset.sup'_le Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i : ZMod n => dist O' (v i))
        (fun i _hi => Metric.mem_closedBall'.mp (hpoly i)))

blocks.tex:
The largest distance to a vertex is continuous in the center and tends to
infinity as the center escapes to infinity, so it attains its minimum.
A disk enclosing $w$ enlarged by $\delta=\max_i|v_i-w_i|$ encloses $v$;
minimality gives $R(v)\le R(w)+\delta$. Reverse the roles of the two vertex
sets. Distinct vertices cannot fit in a radius-zero disk, giving positivity
and continuity of the reciprocal.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-contact-minimality
blocks.title: The contacts determine the minimum radius
blocks.body:
Let $\overline B(O,R)$ be a smallest enclosing disk of a finite vertex set.
If $\rho\ge0$ and $\overline B(C,\rho)$ contains every boundary contact of
that disk, then $R\le\rho$.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.minimalEnclosingDiskR2_le_of_boundaryContactsInClosedDiskR2
lean.code:
theorem minimalEnclosingDiskR2_le_of_boundaryContactsInClosedDiskR2
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ} {O C : ℂ} {R ρ : ℝ}
    (hΔ : MinimalEnclosingDiskR2 v O R) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hcontains : ∀ i : ZMod n, OnDiskBoundaryR2 v O R i →
      InClosedDiskR2 C ρ (v i)) :
    R ≤ ρ := by
  classical
  by_contra hRρ
  have hρR : ρ < R := lt_of_not_ge hRρ
  let slack : ZMod n → ℝ := fun i =>
    if OnDiskBoundaryR2 v O R i then 1 else R - dist O (v i)
  have hslack_pos : ∀ i, 0 < slack i := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : OnDiskBoundaryR2 v O R i
    · dsimp only [slack]
      rw [if_pos hi]
      norm_num
    · dsimp only [slack]
      rw [if_neg hi]
      have hle_i : dist O (v i) ≤ R := Metric.mem_closedBall'.mp (hΔ.2.1 i)
      have hne_i : dist O (v i) ≠ R := fun hdist ↦ hi (Metric.mem_sphere'.mpr hdist)
      have hlt_i : dist O (v i) < R := lt_of_le_of_ne hle_i hne_i
      linarith
  let ε : ℝ := (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod n)).inf'
    Finset.univ_nonempty slack
  have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by
    exact (Finset.lt_inf'_iff Finset.univ_nonempty).2
      (fun i _hi => hslack_pos i)
  have hε_le (i : ZMod n) : ε ≤ slack i := by
    exact Finset.inf'_le slack (Finset.mem_univ i)
  let d : ℝ := dist O C
  let g : ℝ := R - ρ
  have hd_nonneg : 0 ≤ d := by positivity
  have hg_pos : 0 < g := by dsimp [g]; linarith
  have hdg_pos : 0 < d + g := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos hd_nonneg hg_pos
  let t : ℝ := min (1 / 2 : ℝ) (ε / (2 * (d + g)))
  have ht_pos : 0 < t := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact lt_min (by norm_num)
      (div_pos hε_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) hdg_pos))
  have ht_le_half : t ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have ht_le_one : t ≤ 1 := ht_le_half.trans (by norm_num)
  have ht_nonneg : 0 ≤ t := ht_pos.le
  have ht_dg : t * (d + g) ≤ ε / 2 := by
    have ht_ratio : t ≤ ε / (2 * (d + g)) := min_le_right _ _
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht_ratio hdg_pos.le
    calc
      t * (d + g) ≤ (ε / (2 * (d + g))) * (d + g) := hmul
      _ = ε / 2 := by field_simp [hdg_pos.ne']
  let O' : ℂ := AffineMap.lineMap O C t
  let R' : ℝ := (1 - t) * R + t * ρ
  have hR'_nonneg : 0 ≤ R' := by
    dsimp [R']
    exact add_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht_le_one) hΔ.1)
      (mul_nonneg ht_nonneg hρ)
  have hR'_lt : R' < R := by
    dsimp [R', g] at *
    nlinarith
  have hdist_convex (X : ℂ) :
  -- … (truncated)

blocks.tex:
Suppose $\rho<R$. Interpolate the centers and radii:
$O_t=(1-t)O+tC$ and $R_t=(1-t)R+t\rho$.
For a contact $P$, convexity of distance gives $|P-O_t|\le R_t$.
The finitely many noncontacts have a positive minimum radial slack
$\varepsilon$. For sufficiently small $t>0$, their displacement bound
$t|O-C|$ plus the radius loss $t(R-\rho)$ is below $\varepsilon$.
Thus the interpolated disk still encloses every vertex, but has radius
$R_t<R$, contradicting minimality.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-contact-curvature
blocks.title: Curvature at an enclosing-circle contact
blocks.body:
For a simple coherent polygon with positive consecutive orientation, every
contact $v_i$ of its smallest enclosing disk satisfies $\kappa_i\ge1/R$.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.signedMengerProfile_inv_radius_le_of_minimal_boundary_of_cross_pos
lean.code:
theorem signedMengerProfile_inv_radius_le_of_minimal_boundary_of_cross_pos
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ} {OΔ : ℂ} {R : ℝ}
    (hsimple : Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hregular : DahlbergRegular v)
    (hΔ : MinimalEnclosingDiskR2 v OΔ R)
    {i : ZMod n} (hboundary : OnDiskBoundaryR2 v OΔ R i)
    (hcross : 0 < Gluck.Discrete.crossR2 (v (i - 1)) (v i) (v (i + 1))) :
    1 / R ≤ SignedMengerProfile v i := by
  rcases hregular i with hcol | ⟨O, ρ, hcircle, hcone⟩
  · exact False.elim ((ne_of_gt hcross) hcol.1)
  · have hcircle' : CircumcircleR2 (v i) (v (i - 1)) (v (i + 1)) O ρ :=
      ⟨hcircle.1, hcircle.2.2.1, hcircle.2.1, hcircle.2.2.2⟩
    have hρR : ρ ≤ R :=
      circumcircleR2_radius_le_of_inVertexCone_of_boundary
        hcircle' hcone hΔ.1 (Metric.mem_sphere'.mp hboundary)
          (hΔ.2.1 (i - 1)) (hΔ.2.1 (i + 1))
    have hAB : v (i - 1) ≠ v i := by
      simpa using hsimple.1 (i - 1)
    have hcircle'' : CircumcircleR2 (v (i + 1)) (v (i - 1)) (v i) O ρ :=
      ⟨hcircle.1, hcircle.2.2.2, hcircle.2.1, hcircle.2.2.1⟩
    have hκ : SignedMengerProfile v i = 1 / ρ := by
      simpa [SignedMengerProfile] using
        signedMengerR2_eq_inv_circumradius_of_pos hAB hcross hcircle''
    rw [hκ]
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hcircle.1 hρR

blocks.tex:
Translate $v_i$ to zero and write its neighbours as $Q_-,Q_+$. Let $O$
be the enclosing center and $C$ the local circumcenter. Then $|O|=R$,
$|C|=r_i$, and coherence gives $C=aQ_-+bQ_+$ with $a,b\ge0$.
The neighbours lie on the local circle and in the enclosing disk, so
\[
 \langle C,Q_\pm\rangle=\tfrac12|Q_\pm|^2
 \le\langle O,Q_\pm\rangle.
\]
Multiplication by $a,b$ and addition yield
$|C|^2\le\langle O,C\rangle\le R|C|$.
The local circle has positive radius, hence $r_i\le R$ and
$\kappa_i=1/r_i\ge1/R$.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-triple
blocks.title: Contacts confined to three consecutive vertices
blocks.body:
For a simple positively oriented polygon, if all contacts of a smallest
enclosing disk belong to $\{v_{i-1},v_i,v_{i+1}\}$, then $\kappa_i\le1/R$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.curvature_le_level_of_contacts_in_triple
lean.code:
theorem curvature_le_level_of_contacts_in_triple
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ} {O : ℂ} {R : ℝ}
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v) (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v)
    (hD : MinimalEnclosingDiskR2 v O R) (i : ZMod n)
    (hsub : ∀ j, OnDiskBoundaryR2 v O R j →
      j = i - 1 ∨ j = i ∨ j = i + 1) :
    SignedMengerProfile v i ≤ 1 / R := by
  have hr := EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_pos hsimple i
  have hR := radius_pos_of_minimalEnclosingDiskR2_of_isSimplePolygon hD hsimple
  have hle : R ≤ EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile v i := by
    apply minimalEnclosingDiskR2_le_of_boundaryContactsInClosedDiskR2 hD hr.le
    intro j hj
    apply Metric.mem_closedBall'.mpr
    rcases hsub j hj with h | h | h
    · rw [h]
      exact (edgePrevCircle_dist_prev_eq_radius_of_positiveOrientation
        hsimple horient i).le
    · rw [h]
      exact (edgePrevCircle_dist_self_eq_radius_of_positiveOrientation
        hsimple horient i).le
    · rw [h]
      exact (edgePrevCircle_dist_next_eq_radius_of_positiveOrientation
        hsimple horient i).le
  rw [signedMengerProfile_eq_inv_edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_of_positiveOrientation
    hsimple horient i, ← one_div]
  exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hR hle

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-containing-minimum
blocks.title: A containing local circle is a curvature minimum
blocks.body:
If a local circumdisk of a simple coherent positively oriented polygon
contains every vertex, then
$\kappa_i\le\kappa_{i-1}$ and $\kappa_i\le\kappa_{i+1}$.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_neighbors_le_of_containsAll_of_positiveOrientation
lean.code:
theorem edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_neighbors_le_of_containsAll_of_positiveOrientation
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hregular : DahlbergRegular v)
    (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v) {i : ZMod n}
    (hcontains : EdgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll v i) :
    EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile v (i - 1) ≤ EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile v i ∧
      EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile v (i + 1) ≤ EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile v i := by
  exact ⟨
    edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_pred_le_of_containsAll_of_positiveOrientation
      hsimple hregular horient hcontains,
    edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_succ_le_of_containsAll_of_positiveOrientation
      hsimple hregular horient hcontains⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.containing_curvature_le_neighbors
lean.code:
theorem containing_curvature_le_neighbors
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v) (hregular : DahlbergRegular v)
    (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v) {i : ZMod n}
    (hi : EdgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll v i) :
    SignedMengerProfile v i ≤ SignedMengerProfile v (i - 1) ∧
      SignedMengerProfile v i ≤ SignedMengerProfile v (i + 1) := by
  have hh := edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_neighbors_le_of_containsAll_of_positiveOrientation
    hsimple hregular horient hi
  simp only [signedMengerProfile_eq_inv_edgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_of_positiveOrientation
    hsimple horient]
  constructor
  · exact inv_anti₀ (EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_pos hsimple (i - 1)) hh.1
  · exact inv_anti₀ (EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile_pos hsimple (i + 1)) hh.2

blocks.tex:
Compare the circle with each neighbouring local circle across their shared
edge $AB$. A rigid motion puts the endpoints at $(-h,0),(h,0)$, where
$h=|B-A|/2>0$, and the polygon interior above the chord. Coherence at the
incident vertices puts both centers at $(0,y)$ with $y\ge0$. Let
$y_\rho$ denote the neighbouring center parameter and $y_\Delta$ that of the
containing circle. The neighbouring third vertex $(x,t)$ has $t>0$ and
satisfies
\[
 x^2+t^2-2y_\rho t=h^2,\qquad
 x^2+t^2-2y_\Delta t\le h^2.
\]
Thus $y_\rho\le y_\Delta$. Since the squared radius is $h^2+y^2$ and both
parameters are nonnegative, the neighbouring radius is at most $r_i$.
Reciprocal radii reverse both inequalities.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-three-contact
blocks.title: Containing three-contact disks through every vertex
blocks.body:
If $n\ge4$ and a polygon has strict convex edge support, every vertex belongs
to a containing circle with at least three distinct contact vertices.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.exists_dahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2_at_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport
lean.code:
theorem exists_dahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2_at_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsupport : StrictConvexEdgeSupport v) (i : ZMod n) :
    ∃ U : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v,
      i ∈ circleContactSet v U.center U.radius := by
  rcases exists_edgeThirdVertex_circle_containsAll_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport
      hn hsupport i with ⟨j, hji, hjnext, hall, hcircle⟩
  have hAB : v i ≠ v (i + 1) :=
    strictConvexEdgeSupport_edge_ne hn hsupport i
  let y := edgeCircumcenterParameter (v i) (v (i + 1)) (v j)
  let O := edgeCircleCenter (v i) (v (i + 1)) y
  let R := normalizedCircleRadius (chordHalfLength (v i) (v (i + 1))) y
  have hcontains : PolygonInClosedDiskR2 v O R := by
    intro k
    exact Metric.mem_closedBall'.mpr ((mem_edgeClosedDisk_iff_dist_le hAB y).mp (hall k))
  have hiNext : i ≠ i + 1 := by
    intro h
    exact hAB (congrArg v h)
  have hthree : 3 ≤ (circleContactSet v O R).card := by
    apply three_le_card_circleContactSet hiNext hji.symm hjnext.symm
    · exact hcircle.2.1
    · exact hcircle.2.2.1
    · exact hcircle.2.2.2
  let U : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v :=
    { center := O
      radius := R
      radius_pos := hcircle.1
      contains := hcontains
      three_contacts := hthree }
  refine ⟨U, ?_⟩
  exact mem_circleContactSet.mpr hcircle.2.1

deps.title: Positive one-turn polygons have strict edge support
deps.label: detail:discrete-edge-support

blocks.tex:
Fix the outgoing edge at the chosen vertex. Parameterize circles through
its endpoints by their centers on the perpendicular bisector. All other
vertices lie strictly to the same side of the edge, so membership in the
disk is a one-sided inequality on this center parameter. Take the largest
of the finitely many required parameters. The resulting disk contains all
vertices, and a maximizing vertex lies on its boundary along with the two
edge endpoints.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-contact-gap
blocks.title: Localization to a gap in the contacts
blocks.body:
For a strictly convex cyclically indexed polygon, let $U,W$ be containing disks with at
least three contacts each. In a cyclic cut, let $p<k<q<n$. If $p,q$ are
contacts of $U$, $k$ is not a contact of $U$, and $k$ is a contact of $W$,
then every contact of $W$ lies in the closed cyclic interval $[p,q]$.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.circleContactSet_subset_of_containingDisk_cutGap
lean.code:
theorem circleContactSet_subset_of_containingDisk_cutGap
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hgeom : StrictConvexCyclicChordGeometry v)
    (U W : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v)
    (c : ZMod n) {p k q : ℕ}
    (hpk : p < k) (hkq : k < q) (hqn : q < n)
    (hpU : Gluck.cyclicLift c p ∈ circleContactSet v U.center U.radius)
    (hqU : Gluck.cyclicLift c q ∈ circleContactSet v U.center U.radius)
    (hkNotU : Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∉ circleContactSet v U.center U.radius)
    (hkW : Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∈ circleContactSet v W.center W.radius) :
    circleContactSet v W.center W.radius ⊆
      Gluck.mapCut c (Finset.Icc p q) := by
  have hgap := hgeom.gap c p k q hpk hkq hqn
  let a := Gluck.cyclicLift c q
  let b := Gluck.cyclicLift c p
  let z := Gluck.cyclicLift c k
  let E := Gluck.mapCut c (Finset.Icc p q)
  have habIndex : a ≠ b := by
    intro h
    have hcast : (q : ZMod n) = (p : ZMod n) := by
      exact add_left_cancel h
    have hmod : q ≡ p [MOD n] :=
      (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff q p n).mp hcast
    exact (Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_trans hpk hkq))
      (hmod.eq_of_lt_of_lt hqn (lt_trans (lt_trans hpk hkq) hqn))
  apply circleContactSet_subset_of_containingDisk_gap U W hqU hpU hkNotU hkW
    hgap.1
  · intro d hdU hda hdb
    exact hgeom.noncollinear a b d habIndex hda hdb
  · exact hgap.2.1
  · intro x hx
    exact hgap.2.2.1 x ((mem_edgeHalfPlane_iff_crossR2_nonneg hgap.1).mp hx)

blocks.tex:
Write $D=\operatorname{power}_U-\operatorname{power}_W$, an affine function
because the quadratic terms cancel. At $p,q$ it is nonnegative, because
these vertices lie on $U$ and in $W$, whereas $D(k)<0$. If $X$ were a
contact of $W$ outside the closed cut, then $D(X)\le0$, since $X$ lies in $U$.
Strict convex chord geometry makes the segment $kX$ cross the chord $pq$ at
a point $Y$, with positive weight on $k$. Affinity gives $D(Y)<0$ using
$kX$, but $D(Y)\ge0$ using $pq$, a contradiction.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-terminal-intervals
blocks.title: Two terminal contact intervals
blocks.body:
Suppose a nonempty family of disks has contact sets of cardinality at least
three, none equal to the whole cyclic index set. Suppose also that every
index is a contact of some member and that the gap-localization property
holds. There exist two members with distinct contact sets, each a cyclic
interval.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.exists_two_cyclicInterval_contacts_ne_of_cutGap_shrink
lean.code:
theorem exists_two_cyclicInterval_contacts_ne_of_cutGap_shrink
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {Disk : Type*}
    (contacts : Disk → Finset (ZMod n))
    (hthree : ∀ U : Disk, 3 ≤ (contacts U).card)
    (hproper : ∀ U : Disk, contacts U ≠ Finset.univ)
    (hchoose : ∀ i : ZMod n, ∃ W : Disk, i ∈ contacts W)
    (hlocalize : ∀ (U W : Disk) (c : ZMod n) {p k q : ℕ},
      p < k → k < q → q < n →
      Gluck.cyclicLift c p ∈ contacts U →
      Gluck.cyclicLift c q ∈ contacts U →
      Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∉ contacts U →
      Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∈ contacts W →
      contacts W ⊆ Gluck.mapCut c (Finset.Icc p q))
    (U₀ : Disk) :
    ∃ U W : Disk,
      Gluck.IsCyclicInterval (contacts U) ∧
      Gluck.IsCyclicInterval (contacts W) ∧
      contacts U ≠ contacts W := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, hUinterval⟩ :=
    exists_cyclicInterval_contacts_of_cutGap_shrink
      contacts hthree hproper hchoose hlocalize U₀
  obtain ⟨c, p, k, q, hcU, hp0, hpk, hkq, hqn, hpU, hqU, hkNotU⟩ :=
    hUinterval.exists_cutGap_in_complement (hthree U) (hproper U)
  obtain ⟨W, hWinterval, hWsub⟩ :=
    exists_cyclicInterval_contacts_subset_cutGap_of_shrink
      contacts hthree hchoose hlocalize U c hp0 hpk hkq hqn hpU hqU hkNotU
  have hIr : Finset.Icc p q ⊆ Finset.range n := by
    intro r hr
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hr
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt hr.2 hqn)
  have hcNotW : c ∉ contacts W := by
    intro hcW
    have hzeroCut : 0 ∈ Gluck.cutFinset c (contacts W) := by
      exact Gluck.mem_cutFinset.mpr
        ⟨Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n), by simpa [Gluck.cyclicLift] using hcW⟩
    have hcutWsub : Gluck.cutFinset c (contacts W) ⊆ Finset.Icc p q :=
      (Gluck.cutFinset_subset_iff c hIr).mpr hWsub
    have hzeroI := Finset.mem_Icc.mp (hcutWsub hzeroCut)
    omega
  refine ⟨U, W, hUinterval, hWinterval, ?_⟩
  intro hUW
  exact hcNotW (hUW ▸ hcU)

deps.title: Localization to a gap in the contacts
deps.label: detail:hexagon-contact-gap

deps.title: Containing three-contact disks through every vertex
deps.label: detail:hexagon-three-contact

blocks.tex:
Cut at a noncontact and take the interval hull of the contacts in this cut.
If the contact set has an internal gap, choose a disk through an index in
that gap. Localization places its contacts in the closed gap. There are at
least three contacts, so a gap between consecutive contacts is a proper
subinterval of the current hull. The cut base remains omitted, and each
replacement strictly decreases the finite hull until the contacts form
a cyclic interval. Its at least three contacts provide an interior contact
that can serve as the base of a new cyclic cut. Properness provides a
complementary gap whose two endpoints are contacts but whose interior contains
a noncontact. Descend inside that closed gap. Every subsequent contact set
stays in the gap and therefore omits the chosen base contact of the first
interval. The second terminal interval consequently has a different contact
set. All descent measures are natural numbers, so termination requires no
analytic limit.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-two-containing
blocks.title: Two distinct containing curvature circles
blocks.body:
A simple positively oriented strictly convex polygon with $n\ge4$ that is
not concyclic has two distinct local circumcircles whose disks contain all
its vertices.

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.exists_edgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll_of_containing_contacts_interval
lean.code:
theorem exists_edgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll_of_containing_contacts_interval
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon v)
    (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v)
    (U : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v)
    (hinterval : Gluck.IsCyclicInterval
      (circleContactSet v U.center U.radius)) :
    ∃ i : ZMod n,
      EdgePrevCurvatureCircleData v i = (U.center, U.radius) ∧
      EdgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll v i := by
  obtain ⟨i, hprev, hself, hnext⟩ :=
    hinterval.exists_three_consecutive U.three_contacts
  have hprev' : OnDiskBoundaryR2 v U.center U.radius (i - 1) :=
    Metric.mem_sphere'.mpr (mem_circleContactSet.mp hprev)
  have hself' : OnDiskBoundaryR2 v U.center U.radius i :=
    Metric.mem_sphere'.mpr (mem_circleContactSet.mp hself)
  have hnext' : OnDiskBoundaryR2 v U.center U.radius (i + 1) :=
    Metric.mem_sphere'.mpr (mem_circleContactSet.mp hnext)
  have hdata := edgePrevCurvatureCircleData_eq_of_three_boundaries_of_cross_pos
    hsimple U.radius_pos hprev' hself' hnext' (horient i)
  refine ⟨i, hdata, ?_⟩
  have hcenter : EdgePrevCircleCenterProfile v i = U.center :=
    congrArg Prod.fst hdata
  have hradius : EdgePrevCircleRadiusProfile v i = U.radius :=
    congrArg Prod.snd hdata
  simp only [EdgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll]
  intro j
  rw [hcenter, hradius]
  exact U.contains j

lean.name: Gluck.Forward.dahlbergE2Theorem6Lemma5ContainingDisks
lean.code:
theorem dahlbergE2Theorem6Lemma5ContainingDisks
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 4 ≤ n) {v : ZMod n → ℂ}
    (hsimple : Gluck.Discrete.IsSimplePolygon v)
    (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v)
    (hsupport : StrictConvexEdgeSupport v)
    (hgeom : StrictConvexCyclicChordGeometry v)
    (hnoncircle : ¬ Concyclic v) :
    Nonempty (DahlbergE2Theorem6ContainingDisksCertificate v) := by
  classical
  let contacts : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v → Finset (ZMod n) :=
    fun U => circleContactSet v U.center U.radius
  have hthree : ∀ U : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v,
      3 ≤ (contacts U).card := by
    intro U
    exact U.three_contacts
  have hproper : ∀ U : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v,
      contacts U ≠ Finset.univ := by
    intro U
    exact circleContactSet_ne_univ_of_not_concyclic U.radius_pos hnoncircle
  have hchoose : ∀ i : ZMod n,
      ∃ W : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v, i ∈ contacts W := by
    intro i
    exact exists_dahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2_at_of_strictConvexEdgeSupport
      hn hsupport i
  have hlocalize :
      ∀ (U W : DahlbergContainingThreeContactDiskR2 v) (c : ZMod n)
        {p k q : ℕ},
        p < k → k < q → q < n →
        Gluck.cyclicLift c p ∈ contacts U →
        Gluck.cyclicLift c q ∈ contacts U →
        Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∉ contacts U →
        Gluck.cyclicLift c k ∈ contacts W →
        contacts W ⊆ Gluck.mapCut c (Finset.Icc p q) := by
    intro U W c p k q hpk hkq hqn hpU hqU hkNotU hkW
    exact circleContactSet_subset_of_containingDisk_cutGap
      hgeom U W c hpk hkq hqn hpU hqU hkNotU hkW
  obtain ⟨U₀, _h0⟩ := hchoose 0
  obtain ⟨U, W, hUinterval, hWinterval, hcontactsNe⟩ :=
    exists_two_cyclicInterval_contacts_ne_of_cutGap_shrink
      contacts hthree hproper hchoose hlocalize U₀
  obtain ⟨i, hdataU, hcontainsU⟩ :=
    exists_edgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll_of_containing_contacts_interval
      hsimple horient U hUinterval
  obtain ⟨j, hdataW, hcontainsW⟩ :=
    exists_edgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll_of_containing_contacts_interval
      hsimple horient W hWinterval
  have hdistinct : EdgePrevCurvatureCirclesDistinct v i j := by
    intro hij
    apply hcontactsNe
    apply circleContactSet_eq_of_circleData_eq
    exact hdataU.symm.trans (hij.trans hdataW)
  exact ⟨⟨i, j, hcontainsU, hcontainsW, hdistinct⟩⟩

deps.label: detail:discrete-edge-support

deps.title: Two terminal contact intervals
deps.label: detail:hexagon-terminal-intervals

blocks.tex:
Use the family of containing three-contact disks. Nonconcyclicity makes
every contact set proper. The preceding lemmas give two different terminal
contact intervals. Each interval contains three consecutive indices, whose
noncollinear vertices determine their unique local circumcircle. Thus each
terminal disk is a local circumdisk. Equal circle data would give equal
contact sets, so the two resulting circles are distinct.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-profile
blocks.title: An admissible hexagon path
blocks.body:
For $0\le s\le1$, put
\[
 \kappa_s=(14,11,10+3s,5,7-3s,3).
\]
This is a continuous path of positive nonconstant admissible profiles.
Its four-vertex levels are exactly
\[
 (5,7-3s)\ \cup\ (11,10+3s),
\]
where an interval is empty if its upper endpoint is no larger than its lower.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.bandProfile
lean.code:
def bandProfile (s : ℝ) : ZMod 6 → ℝ :=
  ![14, 11, 10 + 3 * s, 5, 7 - 3 * s, 3]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.bandProfile_pos
lean.code:
theorem bandProfile_pos {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∀ i, 0 < bandProfile s i := by
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [bandProfile] <;> linarith [hs.1, hs.2]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.bandProfile_admissible
lean.code:
theorem bandProfile_admissible {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    DiscreteFourVertexPos (bandProfile s) := by
  refine ⟨bandProfile_pos hs, Or.inr ?_⟩
  by_cases h : s < 2 / 3
  · refine ⟨(5 + (7 - 3 * s)) / 2, by linarith, ?_⟩
    exact (bandProfile_dfv_iff hs).2 (Or.inl ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
  · refine ⟨(11 + (10 + 3 * s)) / 2, by linarith, ?_⟩
    exact (bandProfile_dfv_iff hs).2 (Or.inr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.continuous_bandProfile
lean.code:
theorem continuous_bandProfile : Continuous bandProfile := by
  apply continuous_pi
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [bandProfile] <;> fun_prop

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.bandProfile_nonconstant
lean.code:
theorem bandProfile_nonconstant (s : ℝ) :
    ¬ ∃ c, ∀ i, bandProfile s i = c := by
  rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
  have h0 := hc 0
  have h5 := hc 5
  norm_num [bandProfile] at h0 h5
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.bandProfile_dfv_iff
lean.code:
theorem bandProfile_dfv_iff {s c : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    DFV (bandProfile s) c ↔
      (5 < c ∧ c < 7 - 3 * s) ∨ (11 < c ∧ c < 10 + 3 * s) := by
  constructor
  · intro hd
    obtain ⟨b₁, b₂, b₃, b₄, h₁₂, h₂₃, h₃₄, h₄, ht⟩ := hd.exists_increasing
    have hb₁ : b₁ ≤ 2 := by omega
    have hb₂ : b₂ ≤ 3 := by omega
    have hb₃ : b₃ ≤ 4 := by omega
    rcases ht with ⟨h1,h2,h3,h4⟩ | ⟨h1,h2,h3,h4⟩
    all_goals
      interval_cases b₁ <;> interval_cases b₂ <;> try omega
    all_goals
      interval_cases b₃ <;> interval_cases b₄ <;> try omega
    all_goals
      norm_num [bandProfile] at h1 h2 h3 h4
      first
      | exact Or.inl ⟨by linarith [hs.1, hs.2], by linarith [hs.1, hs.2]⟩
      | exact Or.inr ⟨by linarith [hs.1, hs.2], by linarith [hs.1, hs.2]⟩
  · rintro (⟨hl, hu⟩ | ⟨hl, hu⟩)
    · refine ⟨0, 3, 4, 5, by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
      norm_num [bandProfile]
      exact ⟨by linarith [hs.1], hl, hu, by linarith⟩
    · refine ⟨0, 1, 2, 5, by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
      norm_num [bandProfile]
      exact ⟨by linarith [hs.2], hl, hu, by linarith⟩

blocks.tex:
Enumerating the four alternating entries in cyclic order gives the stated
two intervals. The lower interval is nonempty for $s<2/3$, while the upper
one is nonempty for $s>1/3$; thus at least one is nonempty throughout the
path. All entries are positive, and the entries $14$ and $3$ preclude a
constant profile.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-no-nine
blocks.title: The separating level is impossible
blocks.body:
For any simple coherent positively oriented realization of $\kappa_s$,
with $0\le s\le1$, the enclosing level $c=1/R$ is different from $9$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.band_enclosing_level_ne_nine
lean.code:
theorem band_enclosing_level_ne_nine {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    {v : ZMod 6 → ℂ} (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hregular : DahlbergRegular v) (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v)
    (hκ : SignedMengerProfile v = bandProfile s) :
    1 / enclosingRadius v ≠ 9 := by
  intro heq
  have hD := enclosingDisk_minimal v
  have hcontacts : ∀ j, OnDiskBoundaryR2 v (enclosingCenter v) (enclosingRadius v) j →
      j = 0 ∨ j = 1 ∨ j = 2 := by
    intro j hj
    have hh := signedMengerProfile_inv_radius_le_of_minimal_boundary_of_cross_pos
      hsimple hregular hD hj (horient j)
    rw [hκ, heq] at hh
    fin_cases j
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)
    · norm_num [bandProfile] at hh
    · change (9 : ℝ) ≤ 7 - 3 * s at hh
      linarith [hs.1]
    · norm_num [bandProfile] at hh
  have hh := curvature_le_level_of_contacts_in_triple hsimple horient hD 1
    (by simpa only [show (1 : ZMod 6) - 1 = 0 by decide,
      show (1 : ZMod 6) + 1 = 2 by decide] using hcontacts)
  rw [hκ, heq] at hh
  norm_num [bandProfile] at hh

blocks.tex:
If $c=9$, contact curvature is at least $9$. Entries $3,4,5$ of the profile
are smaller than $9$, so all contacts lie among indices $0,1,2$.
The three-contact bound at index $1$ then gives $11=\kappa_1\le c=9$,
a contradiction.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-endpoint-zero
blocks.title: The first endpoint is below the gap

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.band_zero_enclosing_level_le_seven
lean.code:
theorem band_zero_enclosing_level_le_seven
    {v : ZMod 6 → ℂ} (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hregular : DahlbergRegular v) (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v)
    (hκ : SignedMengerProfile v = bandProfile 0) :
    1 / enclosingRadius v ≤ 7 := by
  by_contra hnot
  have hgt : 7 < 1 / enclosingRadius v := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  simp only [one_div] at hgt
  have hD := enclosingDisk_minimal v
  have hc (j) (hj : OnDiskBoundaryR2 v (enclosingCenter v) (enclosingRadius v) j) :
      1 / enclosingRadius v ≤ bandProfile 0 j := by
    rw [← hκ]
    exact signedMengerProfile_inv_radius_le_of_minimal_boundary_of_cross_pos
      hsimple hregular hD hj (horient j)
  have hsub : ∀ j, OnDiskBoundaryR2 v (enclosingCenter v) (enclosingRadius v) j →
      j = 0 ∨ j = 1 ∨ j = 2 := by
    intro j hj
    have hh := hc j hj
    fin_cases j
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)
    all_goals norm_num [bandProfile] at hh; linarith
  have h11 := curvature_le_level_of_contacts_in_triple hsimple horient hD 1
    (by simpa only [show (1 : ZMod 6) - 1 = 0 by decide,
      show (1 : ZMod 6) + 1 = 2 by decide] using hsub)
  rw [hκ] at h11
  norm_num [bandProfile] at h11
  have hsub' : ∀ j, OnDiskBoundaryR2 v (enclosingCenter v) (enclosingRadius v) j →
      j = 0 ∨ j = 1 := by
    intro j hj
    have hh := hc j hj
    fin_cases j
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr rfl
    all_goals norm_num [bandProfile] at hh; linarith
  have h14 := curvature_le_level_of_contacts_in_triple hsimple horient hD 0 (by
    intro j hj
    rcases hsub' j hj with rfl | rfl <;> simp)
  rw [hκ] at h14
  norm_num [bandProfile] at h14
  have hsingle : ∀ j, OnDiskBoundaryR2 v (enclosingCenter v) (enclosingRadius v) j →
      j = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    have hh := hc j hj
    fin_cases j
    · rfl
    all_goals norm_num [bandProfile] at hh; linarith
  have hRle : enclosingRadius v ≤ 0 := by
    apply minimalEnclosingDiskR2_le_of_boundaryContactsInClosedDiskR2
      (C := v 0) hD le_rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [hsingle j hj]
    exact Metric.mem_closedBall'.mpr (by simp)
  exact (not_le_of_gt
    (radius_pos_of_minimalEnclosingDiskR2_of_isSimplePolygon hD hsimple)) hRle

blocks.tex:
Suppose $c>7$. Contact curvature excludes indices $3,4,5$, so the triple at
index $1$ gives $c\ge11$. This excludes index $2$, leaving contacts only at
$0,1$. The triple at index $0$ now gives $c\ge14$, excluding index $1$ too.
All contacts would then be the single vertex $v_0$. A radius-zero disk
contains these contacts, so contact minimality forces $R\le0$, contradicting
positivity of the enclosing radius of a simple polygon.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-endpoint-one
blocks.title: The last endpoint is above the gap

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.band_one_enclosing_level_ge_eleven
lean.code:
theorem band_one_enclosing_level_ge_eleven
    {v : ZMod 6 → ℂ} (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hregular : DahlbergRegular v) (horient : PositivePolygonOrientation v)
    (hκ : SignedMengerProfile v = bandProfile 1) :
    11 ≤ 1 / enclosingRadius v := by
  have hnoncircle : ¬ Concyclic v := by
    intro hcircle
    have hconst := exists_constant_signedMengerProfile_of_concyclic_positiveOrientation
      hsimple hcircle horient
    exact bandProfile_nonconstant 1 (by simpa [hκ] using hconst)
  have hsupport : StrictConvexEdgeSupport v :=
    strictConvexEdgeSupport_of_simple_positiveOrientation hsimple horient
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := dahlbergE2Theorem6Lemma5ContainingDisks
    (by norm_num : 4 ≤ 6) hsimple horient hsupport
    (strictConvexCyclicChordGeometry_of_edgeSupport hsupport) hnoncircle
  by_contra hnot
  have hlt : 1 / enclosingRadius v < 11 := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  simp only [one_div] at hlt
  have hi (i : ZMod 6) (hcontains : EdgePrevCurvatureDiskContainsAll v i) : i = 5 := by
    have hn := containing_curvature_le_neighbors hsimple hregular horient hcontains
    have hl := signedMengerProfile_le_inv_minimalRadius_of_curvatureDiskContainsAll
      hsimple (enclosingDisk_minimal v) hcontains (horient i)
    rw [hκ] at hn hl
    fin_cases i
    · change (14 : ℝ) ≤ 3 ∧ 14 ≤ 11 at hn
      norm_num at hn
    · norm_num [bandProfile] at hl
      linarith
    · change (10 + 3 * (1 : ℝ)) ≤ 11 ∧ (10 + 3 * (1 : ℝ)) ≤ 5 at hn
      norm_num at hn
    · change (5 : ℝ) ≤ 10 + 3 * 1 ∧ 5 ≤ 7 - 3 * 1 at hn
      norm_num at hn
    · change (7 - 3 * (1 : ℝ)) ≤ 5 ∧ (7 - 3 * (1 : ℝ)) ≤ 3 at hn
      norm_num at hn
    · rfl
  have heq : D.i = D.j := (hi D.i D.contains_i).trans (hi D.j D.contains_j).symm
  exact D.distinct (congrArg (EdgePrevCurvatureCircleData v) heq)

blocks.tex:
A positively oriented concyclic polygon has constant curvature, so this
realization is not concyclic. There are two distinct containing local
circles. A containing circle occurs at a weak local curvature minimum;
for this profile only indices $1$ and $5$ qualify. Distinct circles require
distinct indices, so one is the circle at index $1$, of radius $1/11$.
Its disk encloses all vertices, hence $R\le1/11$ and $c\ge11$.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-geometric-obstruction
blocks.title: No continuous choice of the actual polygons
blocks.body:
There is no continuous vertex path $s\mapsto v(s)$ on $[0,1]$ such that
each $v(s)$ is a simple coherent positively oriented hexagon with signed
Menger curvature $\kappa_s$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.no_continuous_coherent_hexagon_path
lean.code:
theorem no_continuous_coherent_hexagon_path :
    ¬ ∃ p : ℝ → (ZMod 6 → ℂ), ContinuousOn p (Set.Icc 0 1) ∧
      ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        IsSimplePolygon (p s) ∧ DahlbergRegular (p s) ∧
        PositivePolygonOrientation (p s) ∧ SignedMengerProfile (p s) = bandProfile s := by
  rintro ⟨p, hp, hphysical⟩
  let c : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => 1 / enclosingRadius (p s)
  have hc : ContinuousOn c (Set.Icc 0 1) := by
    apply continuousOn_const.div (enclosingRadius_lipschitz.continuous.comp_continuousOn hp)
    intro s hs
    exact (radius_pos_of_minimalEnclosingDiskR2_of_isSimplePolygon
      (enclosingDisk_minimal (p s)) (hphysical s hs).1).ne'
  obtain ⟨hS0,hR0,hO0,hK0⟩ := hphysical 0 (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨hS1,hR1,hO1,hK1⟩ := hphysical 1 (by norm_num)
  have h0 : c 0 ≤ 7 := band_zero_enclosing_level_le_seven hS0 hR0 hO0 hK0
  have h1 : 11 ≤ c 1 := band_one_enclosing_level_ge_eleven hS1 hR1 hO1 hK1
  obtain ⟨s, hs, heq⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) hc
    (show (9 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (c 0) (c 1) from ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
  obtain ⟨hS,hR,hO,hK⟩ := hphysical s hs
  exact band_enclosing_level_ne_nine hs hS hR hO hK heq

The function $c(s)=1/R(v(s))$ would be continuous, with $c(0)\le7$ and
$c(1)\ge11$. The intermediate value theorem would give $c(s)=9$ somewhere,
contradicting the separating-level lemma.

blocks.label: detail:hexagon-tabachnikov-obstruction
blocks.title: Pointwise realization without global continuous selection
blocks.body:
Each $\kappa_s$ has a realization in the moderate-arc, closed, full-turn,
simple-polygon sense of the discrete converse. There is nevertheless no
choice of lengths giving these properties for every $s\in[0,1]$ whose
realized vertices depend continuously on $s$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.no_continuous_tabachnikov_hexagon_path
lean.code:
theorem no_continuous_tabachnikov_hexagon_path :
    ¬ ∃ lengths : ℝ → (ZMod 6 → ℝ),
      ContinuousOn (fun s => polygonR2 (bandProfile s) (lengths s)) (Set.Icc 0 1) ∧
      ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ModerateArc 0 (bandProfile s) (lengths s) ∧
        closureGap (bandProfile s) (lengths s) = 0 ∧
        turningSum (bandProfile s) (lengths s) = 2 * Real.pi ∧
        IsSimplePolygon (polygonR2 (bandProfile s) (lengths s)) := by
  rintro ⟨lengths, hp, hreal⟩
  apply no_continuous_coherent_hexagon_path
  refine ⟨fun s => polygonR2 (bandProfile s) (lengths s), hp, ?_⟩
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hMA,hE,hT,hS⟩ := hreal s hs
  have hK : SignedMengerProfile (polygonR2 (bandProfile s) (lengths s)) = bandProfile s := by
    funext i
    let k := (i - 1).val
    have hk : (k : ZMod 6) = i - 1 := ZMod.natCast_rightInverse _
    have hh := signedMengerR2_development hMA k
    simpa only [SignedMengerProfile, vertexR2_eq_polygon hE hT,
      Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, hk, sub_add_cancel] using hh
  exact ⟨hS, dahlbergRegular_of_locallyRegular hS
      (locallyRegular_development_moderate hMA (bandProfile_pos hs) hE hT),
    positiveOrientation_of_signedMengerProfile_pos hS
      (by rw [hK]; exact bandProfile_pos hs), hK⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.GlobalContinuity.dahlbergRegular_of_locallyRegular
lean.code:
theorem dahlbergRegular_of_locallyRegular
    {n : ℕ} {v : ZMod n → ℂ} (hsimple : IsSimplePolygon v)
    (hlocal : LocallyRegularR2 v) : DahlbergRegular v := by
  intro i
  obtain ⟨hcross, hcone⟩ := hlocal i
  let C := circumcenterR2 (v i) (v (i - 1)) (v (i + 1))
  have heq := circumcenterR2_equidist hcross
  have hCne : C ≠ v i := by
    intro h
    have hp : dist C (v (i - 1)) = dist C (v i) := heq.1
    rw [h, dist_self] at hp
    exact hsimple.1 (i - 1) (by simpa using (dist_eq_zero.mp hp).symm)
  right
  refine ⟨C, dist C (v i), ⟨dist_pos.mpr hCne, heq.1, rfl, heq.2⟩, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a,b,ha,hb,he⟩ := hcone
  refine ⟨a,b,ha,hb,?_⟩
  dsimp [C]
  rw [he]
  ring

blocks.tex:
Pointwise existence follows by applying the discrete converse to the positive
admissible profile. Moderate arcs give local coherence and exact signed
Menger curvature; positivity gives positive consecutive orientation. Thus
any continuous path of realized vertices would satisfy all the hypotheses
of the geometric obstruction. This excludes even a selection assuming only
vertex continuity, without requiring continuous or differentiable lengths.
